name: Staekske Rape
description: Staekske Rape (Limburgish: 'Pick Up the Stock') is a Dutch Jass game played in Maastricht and surrounding areas. It is played by four players with a 32-card deck (7s through Aces), featuring a bidding process where the winner takes the 4-card 'Stock' and names trumps. It combines trick-taking with meld declarations ('Stoek' and 'Vier' - 4 of a kind, sequence of 3+).

content.text: Staekske Rape (Limburgish: 'Pick Up the Stock') is a Dutch Jass game played in Maastricht and surrounding areas. It is played by four players with a 32-card deck (7s through Aces), featuring a bidding process where the winner takes the 4-card 'Stock' and names trumps. It combines trick-taking with meld declarations ('Stoek' and 'Vier' - 4 of a kind, sequence of 3+).
Dates to the 19th century as a local variant of Klaverjassen/Jass. The name is dialect for 'Stock Grabbing'.
Four players (or five with dealer sitting out each hand).
32 cards: A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7 in clubs, spades, hearts, diamonds (French or Dutch indices).

First dealer: deal face-up clockwise until someone receives a jack. Then shuffle, player to dealer's right cuts. Deal clockwise: 3 cards to each player, 4 face-down in centre (stock), then 4 cards to each player. Everyone has 7 cards.

items.text: Blind 2: On first round only, a player may bid 2 without looking at cards (contract 120 points). Next bid over blind 2 must be 4, not 3.
Without stock: Declarer may choose to play with original 7 cards without taking the stock. Card points in stock still count for declarer; game points won or lost are doubled.
